findings.claim: CVS 10-K 稱破壞式創新（現有或新競爭者）已改變且預期持續改變競爭格局，且購買決策越來越由消費者透過公開／私有交易所主導，需發展新能力。
findings.excerpt: Disruptive innovation by existing or new competitors has altered, and is expected to continue to alter, the competitive landscape in the future and require us to accurately identify and assess such alterations and make timely and effective changes to our strategies and business model to compete effectively.

findings.claim: 10-K 列出新興競爭者：新創健保、醫療體系自有保險、非傳統通路（零售）等。
findings.excerpt: Emerging competitors include start up health care benefits plans, provider-owned health 6 plans, new joint ventures (including not-for-profit joint ventures among firms from multiple industries), financial services firms that are distributing competing products on their proprietary Private Exchanges

findings.claim: Blue Shield of California 將 PBM 業務由 CVS Caremark 拆給 Amazon Pharmacy、Cost Plus Drugs 等多家（2023 宣布，2025 全面上線），為 PBM 替代模式的實例；非 2026 新聞。
findings.source: CNBC: CVS stock plunges after Blue Shield of California drops retailer's pharmacy services

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年具體新替代技術報導；AI 相關為 CVS 自身投資與監管風險。
